numerical_failure.observed_behavior: When SimpleImputer(strategy="constant") is fit/transformed on an integer-dtype array, the float fill_value is silently cast to integer (e.g. 3.2 becomes 3); when fill_value is np.nan nothing is imputed and a RuntimeWarning 'invalid value encountered in cast' is raised from multiarray.copyto(a, fill_value, casting='unsafe').
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: Either raise an error (or a warning for the fill_value=3.2 case), or cast the array to float so the imputed value is kept, e.g. array([[3.2],[3.2],[3.2],[1.]]) for fill_value=3.2 and array([[nan],[nan],[nan],[1.]]) for fill_value=np.nan. The fix in the PR raises ValueError with a message containing 'cannot be cast to the input dtype' when np.can_cast(fill_value_dtype, X.dtype, casting='same_kind') fails.
trigger_conditions: strategy='constant' with a float fill_value such as 3.2
fill_value=np.nan with integer input, producing a RuntimeWarning and no imputation
